Out-of-tree plugin; no harness patches required."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Agents get three tools — `gpu_status`, `gpu_exec`, `gpu_run_bg` — plus an optional per-step GPU cont"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ext line. Cards are selected automatically (freest first) with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` set in the com"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"mand environment; pin a card explicitly when you care."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **`gpu_status`** — one query, every device: memory used/total, SM utilization, temperature, and a "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"free/busy verdict. A device is *busy* at or above 80% memory used or 50% utilization (both configura"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ble).
- **`gpu_exec`** — one-shot command with a selected card: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<freest>` is p"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"assed through the mounted `ctx.shell` executor's environment. Auto-select or pin `gpuIndex`; select "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"`count` cards for multi-GPU commands.
- **`gpu_run_bg`** — long-running GPU jobs (training, inferenc"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"e servers, benchmarks) register as a `gpu` job in `ctx.jobs`: returns a job id immediately, read wit"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"h `job_output`, stop with `job_kill`.
- **Per-step context** (optional, on by default) — injects a o"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ne-line GPU snapshot into eligible steps (the `time-context` pattern), rate-limited to one sample pe"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"PU snapshot into eligible steps (the `time-context` pattern), rate-limited to one sample per minute."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"All execution rides the **mounted shell executor**. Local host, or any remote execution world (e.g. "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"an SSH provider plugin) — dsh-gpu doesn't know or care where the GPUs are; it queries and launches t"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"hrough the same seam the `bash` tool uses."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"dsh-gpu is an out-of-tree bundle plugin. To override its configu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ration, add an entry with the same `id` to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Load order note: place it after your execution-world plugins (e.g. an SSH provider) so the shell sea"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"m it queries is the one you intend."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Notes & gotchas"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- `nvidia-smi` **ignores** `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` — it always reports physical indices. `gpu_exec` s"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"election still works as intended for CUDA programs; just don't use nvidia-smi output inside `gpu_exe"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"c` to verify the pinning.
- Selection is advisory, not a reservation: two concurrent agents can stil"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"l pick the same card. For exclusive claims, pin `gpuIndex` from a `gpu_status` read in the same step"},{"id":"p18s5","text":".
- `gpu_run_bg` requires the jobs service in the composition (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs` + `@deepseek-"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ai/dsh-tool-jobs`), the same dependency background `bash` has.
- Hosts without NVIDIA GPUs: `gpu_sta"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"tus` reports a clean `no-gpu` result instead of failing."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Test fixtures are recorded from a live 8× Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB host (including one occupied card) — "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"no mocking of nvidia-smi output formats."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
